Name: All of Buffs
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=6]# All of Buffs[/size]

`All of Buffs` changes how consumable buffs behave in Stardew Valley and adds an in-game editor for food and drink buff overrides.

[size=5]## Features[/size]

- Food buff stacking support.
- Per-item food and drink buff override editing in a custom in-game menu.
- Search and filter support in the custom menu.
- Optional fixed top-left buff grid.
- Optional minimized buff icons.
- Optional clockwise filled timer overlay.

[size=5]## Requirements[/size]

- SMAPI `4.0.0` or newer.
- Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but recommended.

[left][size=5]## GMCM Options[/size][/left]
[left][/left]
[size=4]### Food Buffs[/size]

`Enable food buff stacking`

- Lets food buffs stack with other food buffs instead of replacing the previous one.
- This affects food-style consumable buffs. It is the main gameplay behavior toggle for the mod.

`Auto-remove missing item overrides`

- Automatically deletes override entries for foods or drinks that no longer exist.
- This is useful when a content mod adds custom consumables and is later removed.
- When enabled, invalid entries are removed from `consumable-buff-overrides.json` during sync.
- When disabled, invalid entries are kept in the JSON file, but they are not shown or used in-game.

`Open buff menu key`

- Opens the in-game custom menu for food and drink override editing.
- Default key: `X`.

[size=4]### Buff Display[/size]

`Use fixed top-left display`

- Draws stacked food buffs in a custom grid near the top-left of the screen.
- Disable this if you want to rely on Stardew Valley's default buff UI only.

`Minimize fixed icons`

- Shrinks the icons used in the custom fixed grid.
- This only affects the custom top-left display.

`Minimized icon scale`

- Controls how much minimized icons are reduced.
- Available values:
- `1/2`
- `1/3`
- `1/4`

`Show clockwise timer overlay`

- Draws a filled countdown overlay on buff icons.
- The overlay shrinks clockwise like a clock face.

`Timer overlay opacity`

- Controls overlay transparency from `0%` to `100%`.
- Lower values make the icon easier to see underneath.

[size=5]## Custom Menu[/size]

Press the configured hotkey, default `X`, while in-game to open the custom food/drink override menu.

[size=4]### Main Screen[/size]

- Items are shown as paged cards in a `4 x 3` grid.
- Each card shows:
- item sprite
- item name
- Food and drink tabs are separated.

[size=4]### Search[/size]

- Use the search box at the top-right.
- Search accepts:
- localized item name
- item ID / qualified item ID
- Example matches:
- `Coffee`
- `커피`
- `(O)395`

[size=4]### Buff Filter[/size]

- Filter buttons use buff icons.
- Multiple filters can be selected at the same time.
- Filter behavior is additive: an item is shown if it has any matching buff among the selected filters.
- The `All` checkbox clears every active filter.

[size=4]### Item Editor Popup[/size]

Click any item card to open its override editor popup.

Each buff row is:

- `Enabled`
- `Buff name`
- `Value`
- `Duration`

Meaning:

- `Enabled`: whether that buff is applied for the selected item.
- `Buff name`: the buff category, such as Speed, Luck, Mining, Attack, etc.
- `Value`: numeric buff strength.
- `Duration`: duration in real-time seconds.

Duration notes:

- You can enter a number of seconds.
- You can enter `allday` for all-day duration.

[size=4]### Supported Buff Types[/size]

- Farming
- Fishing
- Mining
- Luck
- Foraging
- Max Stamina
- Magnetic Radius
- Speed
- Defense
- Attack
- Buff Duration Added

`Buff Duration Added` increases remaining finite buff time instead of creating a new normal buff icon.

[size=5]## Files[/size]

`config.json`

- Stores global mod settings and hotkeys.

`consumable-buff-overrides.json`

- Stores per-item food and drink override values.

[size=5]## Notes[/size]

- The custom menu only appears in-game.
- GMCM is used for global settings and the hotkey only.
- If code changes are rebuilt while the game is already running, restart the game to fully reload the mod assembly.
